//@version=2
study("For loop")
my_sma(price, length) =>
    sum = price
    for i = 1 to length-1
        sum := sum + price[i]
    sum / length
plot(my_sma(close,14))

expected_result.ru: Среднее close по 14 барам после прогрева.
expected_result.en: Mean close over 14 bars after warmup.

//@version=6

indicator("Once on confirmed bar")
var int count = 0
once barstate.isconfirmed
    count += 1
plot(count, "Expected one after first confirmed bar")

expected_result.ru: После первого подтверждённого бара count равен 1. На realtime rollback состояние до закрытия бара может откатываться; условие isconfirmed существенно.
expected_result.en: Count is one after the first confirmed bar. Realtime rollback can undo state before a bar closes; the isconfirmed condition matters.

indicator("Scope and reassignment")
float outer = close
if close > open
    float outer = high  // Shadows the global variable only inside this block.
float reassigned = close
if close > open
    reassigned := high
plot(outer, "Unchanged global close")
plot(reassigned, "High on bullish bars")

expected_result.ru: outer остаётся close; reassigned меняется на high на растущих барах.
expected_result.en: outer remains close; reassigned becomes high on bullish bars.

//@version=4
// Editorial example; not compiled or executed in Pine.
study("Two RSI contracts in v4")
ordinaryRsi = rsi(close, 14)
numerator = max(change(close), 0.0) + 1.0
denominator = max(-change(close), 0.0) + 1.0
ratioRsi = rsi(numerator, denominator)
ratioFormula = 100.0 - 100.0 / (1.0 + numerator / denominator)
plot(ordinaryRsi, title = "Ordinary RSI")
plot(ratioRsi - ratioFormula, title = "Difference expected zero")

expected_result.ru: Разность ratio-формы и формулы ожидается в пределах 1e-10 на определённых данных. Первый бар может дать na; обычный RSI требует прогрева.
expected_result.en: Ratio-form difference is expected within 1e-10 on defined data. The first bar can be na; ordinary RSI needs warmup.
